content.content:
# Cybereinforce Threat Enforcement (CTE) - Microsoft Sentinel Workbook
Operational visibility for SOC teams: ingestion health, URL blocks, audit activity, and IOC synchronization.

**Data source:** `CybereinforceCTE_CL` custom log table (Logic App / DCR ingestion).

> Tip: Use the workbook time range (top-right) to scope all charts and tables.

content.query:
CybereinforceCTE_CL
| summarize
    TotalEvents = count(),
    AuditEvents = countif(EventType in ("auth.login","token.generated")),
    UrlBlocks = countif(EventType == "block.url"),
    DevicesOnHold = countif(EventType == "device.onhold"),
    IocSyncEvents = countif(EventType has "ioc")
| project TotalEvents, AuditEvents, UrlBlocks, DevicesOnHold, IocSyncEvents
content.title: Key Metrics

content.query:
CybereinforceCTE_CL
| summarize
    LastEvent = max(TimeGenerated),
    FirstEvent = min(TimeGenerated),
    Events = count(),
    Tenants = dcount(TenantId)
| extend IngestionDelayMinutes = (now() - LastEvent) / 1m
| project LastEvent, IngestionDelayMinutes, Events, Tenants, FirstEvent
content.title: Ingestion Health

content.query:
CybereinforceCTE_CL
| summarize Events=count() by Severity
| order by Events desc
content.title: Events by Severity

content.query:
CybereinforceCTE_CL
| summarize Events=count() by EventType
| top 15 by Events
content.title: Top Event Types

content.query:
CybereinforceCTE_CL
| where EventType == "block.url"
| summarize Blocks=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: URL Blocks Over Time

content.query:
CybereinforceCTE_CL
| where EventType in ("auth.login","token.generated")
| summarize Audit=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), EventType
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Audit Activity Over Time (Auth + Token)

content.query:
CybereinforceCTE_CL
| where tostring(Severity) in ("high","critical")
| project TimeGenerated, TenantId, EventType, Severity, Actor, Entity, EntityId, Category, Source, Details
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 200
content.title: Recent High / Critical Events (latest 200)

content.query:
CybereinforceCTE_CL
| where EventType == "block.url"
| extend d=parse_json(tostring(Details))
| extend Url = coalesce(tostring(d.url), tostring(d.Url), tostring(d.blockedUrl), tostring(d.destinationUrl))
| summarize Blocks=count(), Devices=dcount(EntityId), Tenants=dcount(TenantId), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by Url
| where isnotempty(Url)
| top 20 by Blocks
content.title: Top Blocked URLs

content.query:
CybereinforceCTE_CL
| where EventType == "block.url"
| extend d=parse_json(tostring(Details))
| extend Url = coalesce(tostring(d.url), tostring(d.Url), tostring(d.blockedUrl), tostring(d.destinationUrl))
| where isnotempty(Url)
| extend Domain = tostring(parse_url(Url).Host)
| summarize Blocks=count(), Devices=dcount(EntityId), Tenants=dcount(TenantId), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by Domain
| top 20 by Blocks
content.title: Top Blocked Domains

content.query:
CybereinforceCTE_CL
| where EventType == "block.url"
| summarize Blocks=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by TenantId, EntityId
| top 20 by Blocks
content.title: Devices with Most URL Blocks

content.content:
## IOC Synchronization
This section tracks indicators of compromise (IOCs) that are imported/sent between Microsoft security tooling and Cybereinforce.

If your pipeline logs IOC actions under a different `EventType`, update the queries below (search `EventType has "ioc"`).

content.query:
CybereinforceCTE_CL
| where EventType has "ioc"
| summarize IocEvents=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), EventType
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: IOC Events Over Time

content.query:
CybereinforceCTE_CL
| where EventType has "ioc"
| project TimeGenerated, TenantId, EventType, Severity, Actor, Entity, EntityId, Details
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 200
content.title: Recent IOC Events (latest 200)

content.content:
## Audit & Administration
Track authentication and administrative actions that may indicate configuration changes, unusual access, or token misuse.

content.query:
CybereinforceCTE_CL
| where Category in ("admin","audit") or EventType in ("auth.login","token.generated")
| project TimeGenerated, TenantId, EventType, Severity, Actor, Entity, EntityId, Category, Details
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 300
content.title: Recent Admin / Audit Events (latest 300)

content.query:
CybereinforceCTE_CL
| summarize
    Events=count(),
    UrlBlocks=countif(EventType=="block.url"),
    AuditEvents=countif(EventType in ("auth.login","token.generated")),
    DevicesOnHold=countif(EventType=="device.onhold"),
    LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
  by TenantId
| order by Events desc
content.title: Tenant Overview

content.content:
---
### About Cybereinforce CTE
Cybereinforce Threat Enforcement (CTE) provides rapid URL blocking and security event telemetry designed to integrate into SOC operations.

Workbook generated for: **SOC triage, operational monitoring, and incident investigation workflows.**
